value.rationale: Exact unique centers and symmetry values for a full natural one-parameter family of clipped ellipsoids furnish dimension-free benchmarks for symmetry-dependent rounding and center algorithms. Two geometrically different active boundary orbits force the sharp formula. The thin-cap affine blowup yields the nontrivial golden-ratio paraboloid invariant, independently proved. These consequences are not numerical substitutions in the known half-ball case.
